# Terracotta Clay (`terracotta-clay`)

Style of `professional-apple-ui`. Pick ONE per project, record it in the project's `AGENTS.md` (`UI style: terracotta-clay`) and in `docs/ui-style.json`, and generate `Theme.swift` from it; never mix styles.

**Feel**: Earthy and crafted: clay hero on a sand canvas, serif headings, for makers and shops.

**Source of the values**: **computed**: generated by `make_style.py` from the brand hue with the OKLCH recipe calibrated on Mint Studio, then pushed until every reading pair reaches WCAG AA.

## Type and shape

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Font design | `serif` (serif headings, default body) |
| Corner radii (hero / card / tile / thumbnail) | 20 / 16 / 12 / 10 pt |
| Role hues (OKLCH) | brand 47°, info 236°, plan 300°, attention 82°, danger 8° |
